description:
We’ve all been there: you’re wrapping up a late-night gaming session at your computer only to realize your eyes feel like sandpaper. Or maybe you burned a bit of the midnight oil on a big project and now sleep just won’t come and you’re completely wrecked the next morning. The culprit may be blue light, and it’s a problem that one of my go-to apps F.lux aims to solve.

F.lux is a lightweight app that automatically adjusts your screen’s color temperature based on the time of day. During daylight hours, your display stays bright and cool. But as the sun goes down, it gradually shifts to warmer tones that are easier on your eyes and less disruptive to your sleep cycle. The idea is to mimic natural lighting, so your brain doesn’t think it’s high noon at midnight.
